craft_notes: Sthāyin: crooked-entry (vakrā — breath enters life by will, crooked-formed; she the other field). Rows: row 2 (will→enters). Close: higher-lower (the polarity pair closes: uttarādhara kept whole). Rejected: 'kuṇḍalinī rises' — killed: crooked-formed kept (the SHAPE is the verse; no ascent named); 'prāṇāyāma' — killed: breath-goes-life-enters kept (the directional pair, plain).

lines: Breath goes, life enters — will, crooked-formed:
long-formed she, great goddess: other field, higher-lower.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vrajet prāṇo viśej jīva icchayā kuṭilākṛtiḥ | dīrghātmā sā mahādevī parakṣetram parāparā

reads_against.argmap: How does breath enter life? → By will, the crooked-formed breath enters life — the goddess' other field.
c1_essence: Breath, life, will: crooked-formed, she the other field.
